on BatchCreateUserRecords
	local tTarget,tInternalA,tDataA,tOutputA,tResult,tRecordIDs
	// THIS CODE ASSUMES THE ARRAY IS CORRECTLY SET UP FOR CANELADB
	put csvImportBatchCreate into tDataA
	put "local" into tTarget
	put false into tInternalA["delaySend"]
	put cdb_batchCreate(tDataA,tTarget,tInternalA) into tOutputA
	put cdb_result("response") into tResult
	
	// SYNC THE TABLES
	repeat for each key xTableID in tOutputA
		put tOutputA[xTableID] into tRecordIDs
		put cdb_sync(tRecordIDs,xTableID,"local",false,false) into tResult
	end repeat
	
	hide_loading "Hide"
	unlock screen
	get answerDialog(tResult,"OK")
end BatchCreateUserRecords
